title: Latvia and China talk by telephone
summary_full: On Monday, September 14th Latvian Minister of Foreign Affairs Baiba Braže had a telephone conversation with the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China, Wang Yi , to discuss the current situation and future cooperation in connection with the search for Latvian nationals missing after the devastating floods in Nepal and the Tibet Autonomous Region of China, according to a release from the Foreign Ministry.
